SDS_Admin_Hub.name: Main Bullpen / Admin Hub
SDS_Admin_Hub.text: Cramped multi-use workplace hub with desks, carts, open panels, printers, vents, monitors, corporate signage and the nearby taped-off break-room microwave. Busy, readable and maintained.

SDS_West_Corridor.name: West Corridor
SDS_West_Corridor.text: Narrow maintained station corridor with access panels, doors at both ends, safety lighting and a small observation window to spectacular space that the coworkers mostly ignore.

SDS_Break_Room.name: Break Room
SDS_Break_Room.text: Ordinary shared employee break room with microwave, vending machine, chairs, printer/forms and accumulated workplace residue. Institutional, familiar and recognizably workplace-scale.

SDS_Maintenance_Bay.name: Maintenance Bay
SDS_Maintenance_Bay.text: Bright maintained StarTrust maintenance bay with polished white, blue and metal surfaces, accessible equipment housings, diagnostic displays, workbench, approved clamps and mesh, temporary-repair tags and clear service space. Practical working infrastructure, not a shabby workshop.

SDS_Lab_Work_Area.name: Lab Work Area
SDS_Lab_Work_Area.text: Compact immaculate station lab adjoining operations, with sealed physical samples, scanners, test blocks, compression and vibration fixtures, chain-of-custody labels and clean blue-white StarTrust lighting. Scientific workplace, practical and readable rather than mystical.

SDS_Multipurpose_Room.name: Multipurpose Room
SDS_Multipurpose_Room.text: Clean configurable employee room used for meetings, training and wellness programming; ordinary chairs, portable display screen, environmental monitor and a ventilation-damper service chase that must remain physically accessible.

SDS_Quiet_Room.name: Quiet Room
SDS_Quiet_Room.text: Small adjacent employee room with ordinary chairs, water and a simple local sign. Calm because it is uncluttered and optional, not because of mystical or therapeutic visual effects.

SDS_Docking_Vestibule.name: Docking Vestibule
SDS_Docking_Vestibule.text: Bright clean StarTrust docking-entry vestibule with practical hatch hardware, visitor-badge return slot, route markings and a clear transition into the working operations level.

SDS_Galley_Service_Corridor.name: Galley Service Corridor
SDS_Galley_Service_Corridor.text: Maintained blue-white service corridor behind the station galley with water-manifold cabinet, cable junctions, route markings, utility access and enough working clearance for an ordinary small maintenance response.

SDS_Cargo_Bay.name: Cargo Bay / Dock 2
SDS_Cargo_Bay.text: Clean active station cargo bay with conveyor service lane, Dock 2 latch hardware, access barriers, route tags and shuttle-approach status displays. Functional logistics space with clear physical geography and maintained equipment.
